courses.title: Getting Started with Learning and Digital Confidence
courses.purpose: Introduce the learning space, safe learning habits, goal setting and confidence with technology.

ageAdaptation.early: Use short, supervised activities, pictures, oral explanation and breaks. A facilitator may record a dictated response; never require a public child profile. Use a fictional classroom routine with picture cards to explore welcome to desloop and explain a small result. Use familiar objects, pictures and a facilitator-guided example.
ageAdaptation.junior: Use visual examples and checklists, then a short independent task in approved, moderated tools. For this course, practise with welcome to desloop before making the project.
ageAdaptation.teen: Invite deeper reasoning and documented decisions; collaboration and publishing remain moderated and privacy-aware. Explain decisions about goals and routines in your own words.
ageAdaptation.adult: Apply the same competency to a practical study, work or community context with clear documentation. Apply the final module to a mock study or workplace task and document how digital wellbeing improves your result.
